entries.text: Auto-convert pasted V2rayN/Xray-exported JSON and sing-box JSON into mihomo nodes (full config or single outbound), with stream/reality/tls mapping and non-node outbounds skipped
Add an add-node entry to profile card menus and let the add-node panel pick its target profile, defaulting to the profile it was opened from

Fix the manual node form: map the trojan/hysteria2 SNI field to the correct key, always honor the selected ws/grpc transport even without a path or service name, and require the obfs password when obfuscation is enabled
Add a manual node form (socks5/http/shadowsocks/vmess/vless/trojan/hysteria2) with per-protocol dynamic fields that reuses the existing add-proxy-node pipeline
Add a three-state dashboard connection hero, intent-based proxy grouping with matching custom rules, and a first-run best-preset guide
Open the chain-proxy target picker as a regular sheet so the chain-proxy pages stop rendering blank
Skip automatic batch exit tests on metered connections, move the proxy exit store into the drift database, and rebuild proxy consumers per node name
Probe every node's real exit region automatically after a delay test, keep the results on disk, and classify nodes by where they actually land instead of what they are named
Generate strategy groups per region and store them in the override data
Label every proxy card with its region and filter the list by region
Add the region engine: recognise a node's region from its name, bucket it, and plan region groups
Make the subscription update entry a labelled button, add a blank profile, and rework the dashboard
Rework the proxy page cards, make per-node delay testing visible, and add a connect button
Restrict group types to the ones this core supports, fix stored relay groups, and align the group cards
Add the bridge layer: new strings, a drag handle widget, core calls, and models
Give a blank profile default groups, add node import, and move proxy chaining to dialer-proxy
Default to overseas DoH upstreams, migrate existing profiles, and add a DNS leak self-check
Add one-step connect and align the takeover switch with the running state
Add the subscription compatibility layer and default strategy groups
Rebrand the fork as BiLoom
Move the protocol chip onto the second row so all three card types line up
Show every strategy group except the ones explicitly marked hidden
Add GPL attribution, fix the About wording, make update checks tri-state, repair TUN, and default fallback-filter.geoip to false
